derived_cause: Replay drives the ANIMATION pipeline but nothing drives the AUDIO pipeline, because every audio owner lives in the App.svelte branch that replay skips. App.svelte is the only module that imports playBGM/playWin/warmUpAudio (App.svelte:56), and its onMount early-returns for replay at App.svelte:1178 ('if (isReplay) return'), which sits ABOVE playBGM() at App.svelte:1220 and above the first-gesture warmUpAudio registration at App.svelte:1246-1252. So in replay the BGM loop never starts and the decode warm-up listeners are never attached. The tiered win sting is likewise unreachable: playWin's only call sites are App.svelte:741, 1484 and 1505, all inside the live spin/buy handlers, and App.svelte:1697 renders <ReplayMode /> instead of the game markup, so no replay code path can reach them; ReplayMode.svelte imports no audio module at all (import block, ReplayMode.svelte:1-43). The Overdrive bed crossfade is also dead in replay: soundService subscribes to overdriveVisual (soundService.ts:388) and the store's only writer is App.svelte:484, fed by 'bind:overdriveVisualActive' on FreeSpinsPresentation at App.svelte:1944, whereas ReplayMode renders FreeSpinsPresentation without that binding (ReplayMode.svelte:314-318), so the store stays false and setOverdriveBed never fires. The only audio that survives in replay is what GameGrid calls internally from its own animateSpin (GameGrid.svelte:39, 935 playSpinStart, 444/515 playReelStop, 445/516 playScatterLand, 993/1085 playAnticipation), which reaches replay solely because ReplayMode:211-215 calls the same gridRef.animateSpin(board). Hence the asymmetry: the animation half is explicitly replicated ('identical pipeline to live game', ReplayMode.svelte:211) and carries reel SFX along by accident, while music, the win sting and the feature bed are missing. Worst case is the triggered round: ReplayMode.svelte:156-177 plays the feature through FreeSpinsPresentation and returns before ever reaching the animateSpin call at 214, and FreeSpinsPresentation renders its own board and imports no soundService (its imports, FreeSpinsPresentation.svelte:8-25), so a replayed free-spins round is completely silent. This is a compliance defect because the platform spec requires sound in replay: docs/stake-engine-live/game-replay-requirements.md:105 'Play the round as normal - Show all animations, sounds, and visual effects' and :130 'Play full animation - Show all animations, sounds, and results'.
reasoning: Specification first: game-replay-requirements.md:105 and :130 require sounds during replay, so audio is in scope of the replay contract. Then the source: soundService exports playBGM/warmUpAudio/playWin/playClick and the reel SFX; a whole-tree grep for 'soundService' shows the only importers are App.svelte (playBGM, playWin, warmUpAudio), GameGrid.svelte (spin/reel/anticipation/scatter), and three click-only consumers (HudOverlay, FeatureMenu, PaytableModal, IntroSplash). ReplayMode.svelte imports none. App.svelte's onMount returns at 1178 for replay, before playBGM at 1220 and before the warm-up listeners at 1246-1252, so those two never run in replay; the three playWin call sites are all inside live spin/buy handlers that replay cannot enter because 1697 renders ReplayMode instead. The bed swap depends on a store whose sole writer is the App.svelte binding replay does not use. What remains is GameGrid's internal SFX, reachable only via animateSpin, which replay calls at 214 for ordinary rounds and never calls for triggered rounds (early return at 176). Closed-form and fully determined by the import graph plus two early returns; no measurement required.
